_help: Custom background music. The music ROM has ONE custom slot (track 6). Rebuild: python scripts/make_music.py  (it also writes rtl/bgm_cfg.vh), then re-synthesise.
tracks.<name>.file = text 'NOTE:frames ...' (made by scripts/audio_to_music.py from an audio file, or written by hand).
play.<place> = 'default' (built-in track) or the track name. Places: floor1 floor2 floor3 escape win gameover. A custom track loops.
A missing / invalid file never breaks the build: the default music plays and a warning is printed.
